note: Both sets cover the nine Table 5-1 rows with correct values, units and supporting quotes, and both redundantly state the rated rotor speed twice. Set A, however, adds an invented 'Region 3' condition to the rated generator speed and an odd 'baseline' condition to the rotor speed, neither of which the page states as a condition for those values. Set B keeps the same content without fabricating conditions, so it is the cleaner and more faithful set. Neither set captures the prose assumptions (no gearbox frictional losses, 5% critical structural damping ratio, brake time-lag definition).
remarks: Both sets duplicate the rated rotor speed claim (12.1 rpm) under two attribute names. Both omit prose facts that give engineering context: gearbox assumed lossless, driveshaft structural damping ratio of 5% critical (free-free mode, rigid generator and rotor), and the brake time lag meaning time to fully engage with a linear ramp in FAST/ADAMS. Set A's 'Region 3' condition has no support anywhere on the page.
